              MAPATIZYA LAWMAKER HANDS OVER TWO KEY CDF PROJECTS TO THE COMMUNITY OF MANGONDA & ZIMBA WARDS. 2026-04-27 MAPATIZYA LAWMAKER HANDS OVER TWO KEY CDF PROJECTS TO THE COMMUNITY OF MANGONDA & ZIMBA WARDS. The Member of Parliament for Mapatizya Constituency, Emeldah Munashabantu, has commissioned key Constituency Development Fund (CDF) projects aimed at improving education, sanitation, and healthcare services in Zimba District. The commissioned projects include a 1×3 classroom block at Siameja Community School constructed at a cost of K1,265,906.80 and an ablution block with a water reticulation system at Zimba Mission Hospital Mothers’ Shelter, constructed at a total cost of K600,000 under the 2025 CDF. Speaking during the ceremonies, Hon. Munashabantu said the projects reflect the government’s commitment to taking development closer to the people and addressing pressing community needs. She noted that the classroom block will provide a conducive learning environment for pupils who previously relied on inadequate facilities such as a church building, while the health infrastructure will significantly improve sanitation, hygiene, and access to clean water for expectant mothers. Hon. Munashabantu emphasized that the lack of proper sanitation and water supply at the mothers’ shelter had long affected the dignity, health, and safety of women, adding that the newly commissioned facilities will help address these challenges. Meanwhile, Council Chairperson Loveness Chigora reaffirmed the local authority’s commitment to effective service delivery and prudent utilization of public resources. Council leadership noted that CDF continues to play a critical role in transforming communities by funding projects that directly respond to local needs. The Council also stressed the importance of promoting sanitation and hygiene, describing access to clean water and proper sanitation facilities as essential to public health and human dignity. District Commissioner has urged the community, school management, and hospital staff to take ownership of the newly commissioned infrastructure and ensure proper maintenance for long-term sustainability. Published April 27, 2026 By Mastone Moonze Categorized as Uncategorized https://www.zimbacouncil.gov.zm/?p=4201
THE CONSTRUCTION OF MARTENITY AT MAPATIZYA CLINIC IS A MILESTONE TO IMPROVED MARTERNAL HEALTH CARE-DR.MILIMO 2026-04-01                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         THE CONSTRUCTION OF MARTENITY AT MAPATIZYA CLINIC IS A MILESTONE TO IMPROVED MARTERNAL HEALTH CARE-DR.MILIMO Zimba Town Council Director of Health Services, Dr. Milimo Kayawa, has described the construction of a maternity annex under the Constituency Development Fund (CDF) and a mothers’ shelter by Non-Governmental Organisation On-Call Africa in Mapatizya as a significant milestone in improving maternal healthcare. Dr. Kayawa stated that the development represents a major physical transformation that government has delivered to the people of Mapatizya and surrounding areas. She explained that the new facility will allow expectant mothers to stay closer to the health centre, ensuring safer deliveries and access to proper maternal care. Dr. Kayawa further revealed that the maternity annex and mothers’ shelter will serve at least 10 rural health centres in the area, enhancing healthcare delivery across the district. She added that the maternity annex is equipped with both an antenatal clinic and a labour ward, making it easier for medical personnel to provide timely and efficient care to expectant mothers. Dr. Kayawa noted that the availability of these facilities is expected to significantly reduce cases of home deliveries, which often pose risks to both mothers and babies. Meanwhile, Government, through the CDF, has constructed the mothers’ shelter, while On-Call Africa is currently undertaking rehabilitation works at Mapatizya Clinic to further improve healthcare services in Zimba District. Published April 1, 2026 By Mastone Moonze Categorized as Uncategorized https://www.zimbacouncil.gov.zm/?p=4180
       ZIMBA COUNCIL CHAIRPERSON HIGHLIGHTS STRONG PERFORMANCE IN THE IMPLEMENTATION OF GOVERNMENT PROGRAMS. 2026-03-26                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         ZIMBA COUNCIL CHAIRPERSON HIGHLIGHTS STRONG PERFORMANCE IN THE IMPLEMENTATION OF GOVERNMENT PROGRAMS. Zimba Town Council Chairperson, Madam Loveness Chigora, says the local authority has recorded notable success in the implementation of government programmes, attributing this to unity and strong working relationships between elected officials and management. Speaking during a breakfast show on Namwianga Radio Station this morning, Ms. Chigora noted that the district has benefited from a number of development projects due to the progressive policies of the New Dawn Government. She revealed that a total of 926 pupils benefited from the Secondary School Bursaries component between 2022 and 2025, while 930 youths benefited from the Skills Development component over the same period. Additionally, 378 youth and women’s clubs received empowerment grants, and 174 individual businesses and cooperatives accessed loans under the Constituency Development Fund (CDF). Ms. Chigora further commended the dedication of council officers, stating that their commitment to service delivery has greatly contributed to the district’s achievements. She added that Zimba Town Council is among the few local authorities that fully understand and align with the vision of President Hakainde Hichilema in the effective implementation of the CDF. She emphasized that all projects undertaken by the council are community-driven and based on the needs and priorities of the people. Published March 26, 2026 By Mastone Moonze Categorized as Uncategorized https://www.zimbacouncil.gov.zm/?p=4173
                                              ZIMBA COUNCIL URGES CONTRACTORS TO ADHERE TO PROJECT TIMELINES 2026-03-26                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ZIMBA COUNCIL URGES CONTRACTORS TO ADHERE TO PROJECT TIMELINES Zimba Council Secretary, Mr. Lubinda Mwala, has urged local contractors to strictly adhere to contracted project timelines, stating that the local authority will not entertain requests for extensions where funds have been fully disbursed and projects can be completed on time. Speaking during the opening of a contractors and suppliers sensitization meeting held in Zimba this morning, Mr. Mwala emphasized that timely completion of projects, cost-effectiveness, and quality workmanship will be key pillars in the implementation of the 2026 projects. He further called on contractors to ensure they obtain all required documentation legally and avoid compromising their bids through the use of fraudulent or illegal documents. Mr. Mwala reiterated that the local authority remains open and ready to assist citizens and stakeholders in understanding procurement and project implementation processes. He also assured contractors that preference will be given to locally based companies and suppliers in the execution of this year’s Constituency Development Fund (CDF) projects. The meeting featured presentations from the Engineering, Procurement, Legal, and Public Health departments. A total of seventeen local contractors attended the capacity-building session, including: Grerlin Building Limited, Muwemu Investment Limited, Ulonga General Dealers, Soar Construction Solutions, Ju-Gabs General Dealers, Godaso General Dealers, Omega Stationery & General Dealers, Patience Suppliers Zambia Limited, Mimak Construction & General Dealers, Zimba Youth Multipurpose, Militech Enterprise, Koyuma Suppliers, Tonacha General Dealers, Able Innovation, and Africrest Business. Published March 26, 2026 By Mastone Moonze Categorized as Uncategorized https://www.zimbacouncil.gov.zm/?p=4170
                                       ZIMBA TOWN COUNCIL MONITORS CDF-SUPPORTED WATER PUMPS IN MULAMFU WARD 2026-03-13                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ZIMBA TOWN COUNCIL MONITORS CDF-SUPPORTED WATER PUMPS IN MULAMFU WARD Zimba Town Council, through the Department of Planning, this week took time to appreciate and monitor the works being done using the water pumps that the Government, through the Constituency Development Fund (CDF), distributed to beneficiaries in Mulamfu Ward last year. A total of 20 water pumps were provided to help mitigate the effects of climate change by promoting winter farming. The pumps are enabling farmers to produce crops such as maize, vegetables, and other agricultural products, thereby enhancing food security and improving livelihoods in the community. During the monitoring exercise, officers from the Community Development Ms.Ndumwai Madabwali , Socio-Economic Planning Ms.Mainza Maambo and Public Health Mr.Thabo Sitali observed positive progress among the beneficiaries. Some cooperatives have expanded their activities and have even purchased chickens after selling vegetables produced last winter , showing the economic benefits of the initiative. Speaking during the visit, Siankope Zone WDC Zonal Chairperson, Ms. Kizito Munkombwe, said the cooperative is planning to continue with more winter farming activities shortly after the end of the rainy season. “Their target to buy more livestock in the next two years from the few produces they will make from the winter production,” Says Munkombwe. The initiative highlights the impact of the CDF programme in empowering communities and supporting sustainable agriculture in the district. Published March 13, 2026 By Mastone Moonze Categorized as Uncategorized https://www.zimbacouncil.gov.zm/?p=4151

Speaking during the opening of a contractors and suppliers sensitization meeting held in Zimba this morning, Mr. Mwala emphasized that timely completion of projects, cost-effectiveness, and quality workmanship will be key pillars in the implementation of the 2026 projects. He further called on contractors to ensure they obtain all required documentation legally and avoid compromising their bids through the use of fraudulent or illegal documents. Mr. Mwala reiterated that the local authority remains open and ready to assist citizens and stakeholders in understanding procurement and project implementation processes. He also assured contractors that preference will be given to locally based companies and suppliers in the execution of this year’s Constituency Development Fund (CDF) projects. The meeting featured presentations from the Engineering, Procurement, Legal, and Public Health departments. A total of seventeen local contractors attended the capacity-building session, including: Grerlin Building Limited, Muwemu Investment Limited, Ulonga General Dealers, Soar Construction Solutions, Ju-Gabs General Dealers, Godaso General Dealers, Omega Stationery & General Dealers, Patience Suppliers Zambia Limited, Mimak Construction & General Dealers, Zimba Youth Multipurpose, Militech Enterprise, Koyuma Suppliers, Tonacha General Dealers, Able Innovation, and Africrest Business.                                        ZIMBA TOWN COUNCIL MONITORS CDF-SUPPORTED WATER PUMPS IN MULAMFU WARD 2026-03-13                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ZIMBA TOWN COUNCIL MONITORS CDF-SUPPORTED WATER PUMPS IN MULAMFU WARD Zimba Town Council, through the Department of Planning, this week took time to appreciate and monitor the works being done using the water pumps that the Government, through the Constituency Development Fund (CDF), distributed to beneficiaries in Mulamfu Ward last year. A total of 20 water pumps were provided to help mitigate the effects of climate change by promoting winter farming. The pumps are enabling farmers to produce crops such as maize, vegetables, and other agricultural products, thereby enhancing food security and improving livelihoods in the community. During the monitoring exercise, officers from the Community Development Ms.Ndumwai Madabwali , Socio-Economic Planning Ms.Mainza Maambo and Public Health Mr.Thabo Sitali observed positive progress among the beneficiaries. Some cooperatives have expanded their activities and have even purchased chickens after selling vegetables produced last winter , showing the economic benefits of the initiative. Speaking during the visit, Siankope Zone WDC Zonal Chairperson, Ms. Kizito Munkombwe, said the cooperative is planning to continue with more winter farming activities shortly after the end of the rainy season. “Their target to buy more livestock in the next two years from the few produces they will make from the winter production,” Says Munkombwe. The initiative highlights the impact of the CDF programme in empowering communities and supporting sustainable agriculture in the district. top     MAPATIZYA LAWMAKER HANDS OVER TWO KEY CDF PROJECTS TO THE COMMUNITY OF MANGONDA & ZIMBA WARDS.                         NaN  MAPATIZYA LAWMAKER HANDS OVER TWO KEY CDF PROJECTS TO THE COMMUNITY OF MANGONDA & ZIMBA WARDS. The Member of Parliament for Mapatizya Constituency, Emeldah Munashabantu, has commissioned key Constituency Development Fund (CDF) projects aimed at improving education, sanitation, and healthcare services in Zimba District. The commissioned projects include a 1×3 classroom block at Siameja Community School constructed at a cost of K1,265,906.80 and an ablution block with a water reticulation system at Zimba Mission Hospital Mothers’ Shelter, constructed at a total cost of K600,000 under the 2025 CDF. Speaking during the ceremonies, Hon. Munashabantu said the projects reflect the government’s commitment to taking development closer to the people and addressing pressing community needs. She noted that the classroom block will provide a conducive learning environment for pupils who previously relied on inadequate facilities such as a church building, while the health infrastructure will significantly improve sanitation, hygiene, and access to clean water for expectant mothers. Hon. Munashabantu emphasized that the lack of proper sanitation and water supply at the mothers’ shelter had long affected the dignity, health, and safety of women, adding that the newly commissioned facilities will help address these challenges. Meanwhile, Council Chairperson Loveness Chigora reaffirmed the local authority’s commitment to effective service delivery and prudent utilization of public resources. Council leadership noted that CDF continues to play a critical role in transforming communities by funding projects that directly respond to local needs. The Council also stressed the importance of promoting sanitation and hygiene, describing access to clean water and proper sanitation facilities as essential to public health and human dignity. District Commissioner has urged the community, school management, and hospital staff to take ownership of the newly commissioned infrastructure and ensure proper maintenance for long-term sustainability.
